title: AFFLICTION WARLOCK

source.author: Crix
source.name: Mobalytics WoW Forever · Warlock Leveling Guide (Level 1-30)

headline: Get your DoTs rolling, let the demon tank, wand the rest; Life Tap and Drain Life make health and mana one pool.

build.early: Everyone also receives 5 extra 'legacy' talent points (Blizzard gave 16 Legacy Points; five spent on Talented unlock five more) that you can place anywhere: the guide suggests Unholy Power or Malevolence. The guide also has a Demonology variant.

why.Pandemic: Boosts the crit damage of your main spells: one of the strongest Affliction talents.
why.Nightfall: Chance for an instant Shadow Bolt (Shadow Trance).
why.Amplify Curse: Empowers your next curse; macro it with Bane of Agony.
why.Improved Bane of Agony: Buffs one of your main DoTs.

core.t: Your first DoT on long fights: longest duration, least threat.
Instant with 5 points in Improved Corruption; use on elites and big targets.
Filler, or wand it. Instant on a Nightfall proc.
When you need health; Life Tap when you need mana.

items.t: send your demon in first for threat
before Bane of Agony on long fights (3 min)
if the target will live long enough
to finish when you need shards

notes: Visit your trainer every two levels (2, 4, 6 ...) and re-check your action bars after training so you use the new rank.
Keep your armor buff up: Demon Skin early, Demon Armor at level 20 (they do not stack).
Let your DoTs finish the job: do not spend mana on another spell when they will already kill the target.
Always carry Soul Shards: Drain Soul from level 10; shards fuel demons, Healthstones, Soulstones and Ritual of Summoning.
Class quests unlock your demons: Voidwalker at 10, Succubus at 20 (plus Staff of Soran'ruk, Orb and a Soul Pouch), Felhunter at 30.
Use Life Tap only when you have enough health to do it safely, and carry food and water anyway.

stats.t: Your strongest stat. 100 extra Spell Power adds about 160 damage to a full Bane of Agony and 80 to a full Corruption.
Fewer misses. Suppression can give you 5%.
Your main primary stat: it should be on every piece.
Your DoTs and Hellfire can crit.

gear: Spell Power is already on low-level gear in Forever, so you can stack a decent amount early.
Haste is not on gear yet, and your DoTs and Drains are not affected by it.
At this level, the Blackfathom Deeps quest wand (Gravestone Scepter) is described as overpowered: rely on it over Shadow Bolt.
Consumables from the Auction House: Lesser Arcane Elixir (15 Spell Power), Lesser Mageblood Elixir (mp5), Elixir of Wisdom, Briny Seafood Stew (14 Spell Power, 5% XP).

dungeon_gear.items: Gravestone Scepter wand from the class quest chain; the guide calls it overpowered at this level.

dungeon_tips: Curse of the Elements raises your group's magic damage; Curse of Recklessness raises physical damage. Pick by group on bosses and elites.
Use Summon Succubus for damage once you unlock her at level 20, or Voidwalker if you prefer safety.
You can summon allies with Ritual of Summoning when two party members help click the portal.
Soulstone and Healthstone support the whole party.

alliance.note: 2% spell crit while a sword is equipped and 5% Spirit, which also boosts Life Tap.
Expansive Mind now gives 5% mana; Eureka! is a new burst racial. Close to Human.

horde.note: Blood Fury for damage and Shatter Curse for curse/magic protection.
Touch of the Grave drains health on hits and spells.
Berserking does not speed DoTs, drains or channels, so it favors Destruction over Affliction.

races.pick: It is too early to tell: Human or Gnome for the Alliance, Orc or Undead for the Horde.

professions.note: Uses all the cloth you find; half of Warlock BiS comes from Tailoring.
Disenchant unwanted gear and craft Lesser and Greater Magic Wands.
A secondary profession: bandages (Heavy Silk, Mageweave) and health potions.
Mana Well campfire buff restores mana every 5 seconds.
Fish Bowl campfire buff: +8% to all stats.

trainers: Demon quests come from a special Warlock trainer in your faction's main city.
